missed.why: A TI high-bandwidth bipolar latch family P2 did not consider. Datasheet: TMAG5115, SBASAJ1B, December 2022, revised August 2024 (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tmag5115.pdf, read 2026-09-29T07:15:43Z). Sensor type: 'High-speed digital bipolar-latch Hall sensor'. Supply: VCC 2.5 to 26 V (6.3 Recommended Operating Conditions), so 3.3 V +/-3 % is inside. Output: open-drain, 15 mA sink, VOL 0.7 V max at 5 mA, 'Requires a resistor pullup'. Bandwidth: fBW 60 kHz, typical only (6.5); tPD 5 us typ / 6 us max. That is the typical-only limitation P2 accepted for DRV5011. Lowest speed: a latch; the output holds until the opposite pole crosses BRP. Sensitivity (6.6, VCC 2.5 to 26 V, over the operating free-air range): TMAG5115A BOP 0.2 / 1 / 1.7 mT, BRP -1.7 / -1 / -0.2 mT (min / typ / max). ICC 6 mA typ / 8 mA max. TA -40 to 125 C, covering 0 to 85 C. Pins (DBZ SOT-23-3): 1 VCC, 2 OUT, 3 GND, the order of rank 1 DRV5015A1QDBZR. JLCPCB C22455387: stockCount 133, canPresaleNumber 133, expand, USD 0.4419 at qty 1 (vendors.py jlcpcb, 2026-09-29T07:15:27Z); gate 50 (5 boards x 1, never under 50), passed. TMAG5115B1CQDBZR C17587611 has 0 (jlcpcb-search TMAG5115, 07:16:17Z). Digi-Key TMAG5115A1CQDBZR: 2651 (cut tape), Active, lead 16 weeks (vendors.py digikey, 07:18:12Z). TI product page https://www.ti.com/product/TMAG5115 carries <meta name="status" content="ACTIVE"> (07:17:33Z). First revision December 2022, over 12 months on the market. Ranks below DRV5015A1 on operate point (1 mT against 0.7 mT typical) and supply current. Also checked for this function and not passing: DRV5012AEDMRR (C2655038, 5227 at 07:15:33Z) samples at 20 Hz or 2.5 kHz and states no switching bandwidth (drv5012.pdf, 07:15:45Z); ROHM BU52040HFV-TR (C253187, 584 at 07:15:28Z) is intermittent with a 500 us / 1200 us max period and a 3.30 V supply maximum (JLCPCB copy of datasheet Rev.B, https://jlcpcb.com/api/file/downloadByFileSystemAccessId/8588911382549315584, 07:16:40Z); Diodes AH3271Q-P-A/B, AH3280Q-P-A/B, AH3281Q-P-B (50 to 100 at JLCPCB, 07:15:29Z to 07:15:31Z) are two-wire current-output devices (DS41821 Rev. 5-2 and DS41822 Rev. 5-2, JLCPCB copies read 07:16:47Z and 07:16:51Z), not open-drain or push-pull; AH3774-W-7 (C842077, 50) is marked 'NOT RECOMMENDED FOR NEW DESIGNS' (DS37899 Rev. 2-3, 07:16:54Z); AH3712-SA-7 C19948383 0 / presale -9 and AH3712-W-7 C19948384 34 fail rule 4 (07:15:29Z); AH3763Q-SA-7 C842127 0 (07:15:32Z). P2's drop of TMAG5111 holds: Figure 8-3 of SBAS933D (tmag5110.pdf, 07:24:02Z) shows the speed output toggling on the edges of both sensors, not one latch output

Datasheet: TLE4946-2K 'High Precision Hall Effect Latch', Final Datasheet Rev. 1.0, 2008-09-18 (JLCPCB copy, https://jlcpcb.com/api/file/downloadByFileSystemAccessId/8588884725906231296, read 2026-09-29T07:16:43Z). Supply: VS 2.7 to 18 V (Table 3 Operating Range; the title page says 2.7 to 24 V). Output: open collector Q, IQ 20 mA max, VQSAT 0.6 V max at 20 mA, tr and tf 1 us max at RL 1.2 kOhm, CL 50 pF. Switching frequency fSW 0 to 15 kHz, stated as a limit (Table 4); at 15 kHz the field amplitude must be 1.4 times the static threshold. Delay td 13 us typ. Characteristics are guaranteed over the specified voltage and temperature range. Sensitivity (Table 5): BOP 0.5 / 2.0 / 3.5 mT, BRP -3.5 / -2.0 / -0.5 mT, hysteresis 1.0 / 4 / 6.0 mT. IS 2 / 4 / 6 mA. Tj -40 to 150 C; at 3.3 V x 6 mA and RthJA 100 K/W the rise is about 2 K, so 0 to 85 C ambient is inside. Latch: holds its state with the rotor stopped. Pins (SC59): 1 Vs, 2 Q, 3 GND, the order of DRV5015A1; SC59, not SOT-23. JLCPCB C126657: stockCount 255, canPresaleNumber 252, expand, USD 0.5995 at qty 1 (07:15:29Z); gate 50, passed. Digi-Key TLE49462KHTSA1: 6419 (cut tape), 6000 (reel), Active, lead 18 weeks (07:18:19Z). Manufacturer status: https://www.infineon.com/part/TLE4946-2K carries datalayer-productStatusInfo 'active and preferred' for OPN TLE49462KHTSA1, SP000472424 (07:17:33Z). First revision 2008. Ranks below DRV5015A1 on operate point (2.0 mT typical against 0.7 mT) and supply current, above TLE4961-1M on its 15 kHz limit against 10 kHz

missed.maker: Analog Devices (Maxim) (JLCPCB componentBrandEn 'Analog Devices Inc./Maxim Integrated'); counts as Analog Devices (S1)
missed.why: A Maxim comparator family P2 did not consider, with a maximum delay stated over temperature across the whole 2.7 to 5.5 V supply, on rank 1 TLV3201AIDBVR's pinout. Datasheet: MAX961-MAX964/MAX997/MAX999, 19-1129 Rev 8, 12/20 (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/MAX961-MAX999.pdf, vendors.py fetch --client safari, read 2026-09-29T07:19:30Z). Electrical Characteristics at VCC 2.7 to 5.5 V, VCM 0 V, COUT 5 pF: tPD 4.5 ns typ / 7.0 ns max at 25 C and 8.5 ns max over TMIN to TMAX (-40 to +85 C for E grade) at 5 mV overdrive; Note 7: guaranteed by design characterization. That is under the 55 ns share at the index placement and under 21.8 us at the clip. Input common-mode range -0.1 V to VCC + 0.1 V, so 0 V is included. Push-pull output: VOH VCC - 0.52 V at 4 mA source, VOL 0.52 V at 4 mA sink. Internal hysteresis 3.5 mV. ICC 5 mA typ / 6.5 mA max at VCC 5 V, against TLV3201's 40 uA. Input bias current +/-30 uA max over temperature (SOT23), which the round 2 divider must allow for. All other pins -0.3 V to VCC + 0.3 V, the same rail-down limitation P2 reports for its ranks. Operating -40 to +85 C covers 0 to 50 C. SOT23-5 pins: 1 Q (output), 2 GND, 3 IN+, 4 IN-, 5 VCC; TLV3201 DBV is 1 OUT, 2 V-, 3 IN+, 4 IN-, 5 V+, so it is a second-maker part on rank 1's footprint (rule 5 route), subject to the input bias current. JLCPCB C124667: stockCount 2138, canPresaleNumber 2133, expand, USD 1.8698 at qty 1 (vendors.py jlcpcb, 07:20:20Z); gate 50 (5 boards x 2 placements x 5), passed. missed.maker: Texas Instruments (JLCPCB componentBrandEn 'Texas Instruments'); counts as Texas Instruments (S1)
missed.why: A 3 to 5.5 V RS-485 transceiver family P2 did not consider, used as a receiver, one package for each of A, B and I (3 a board, as P2 counted for MAX3280E). Datasheet: THVD1410, THVD1450, THVD1451, THVD1452, SLLSEY3E, May 2018, revised May 2019 (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/thvd1451.pdf, read 2026-09-29T07:22:46Z). VCC 3 to 5.5 V; receiver VOH VCC - 0.4 V at -8 mA, so 3.3 V logic at the GPIO. Input withstand: bus pins -18 to 18 V absolute maximum, -15 to 15 V operating at any bus terminal, over 12 V. Signaling rate 50 Mbps for THVD1450/1451/1452. Receiver switching over the operating free-air range: tPHL, tPLH 25 ns typ / 40 ns max at CL 15 pF, pulse skew 3.5 ns max, output tr/tf 2 / 6 ns. No minimum delay and no part-to-part skew is stated, so the skew between the 3 packages is bounded by the 40 ns maximum, under the 50 ns of V227. Single-ended form: A against a reference on B, thresholds VTH+ -100 / -20 mV and VTH- -200 / -130 mV over +/-15 V common mode, hysteresis 30 mV. Powered-off behaviour: bus input current II at DE 0 V, VCC 0 V or 5.5 V: 50 / 125 uA at VI 12 V, -100 / -65 uA at -7 V. Characterized over -40 to 125 C, covering 0 to 50 C. The driver is held off with DE low. JLCPCB C1850237 THVD1452DR (SOIC-14): 2213, presale 2172, USD 1.2947 at qty 1 (07:23:20Z); C2671361 THVD1450DR (SOIC-8, half duplex): 1913, presale 1546, USD 0.9162 (07:23:19Z); gate 75 (5 boards x 3 placements x 5), both passed. Digi-Key THVD1452DR: 1584, Active, 16 weeks (07:23:45Z); THVD1450DR: 0, Active, 16 weeks (07:23:31Z); THVD1451DR: 0 (07:23:43Z). TI product pages https://www.ti.com/product/THVD1452 (07:26:02Z) and https://www.ti.com/product/THVD1450 (07:23:31Z) carry <meta name="status" content="ACTIVE">. Ranks below the quad receivers for 3 packages a board, a skew bound of 40 ns against AM26LV32E's stated 9 ns, and no stated receiver output figure at VCC 0 V. SEARCHED WITHOUT A PASSING FIND, for the record. Accelerometer: NXP FXLN8362QR1 C2687846 0 / 0 and FXLN8361QR1 C5190735 0 / 0 (vendors.py jlcpcb, 07:09:46Z, 07:09:47Z); no JLCPCB rows for ADXL001, ADXL321, ADXL78 or ADXL193 (jlcpcb-search, 07:09:58Z to 07:10:03Z); ROHM KXR94 rows all 0 (07:10:06Z); ADXL1002BCPZ 0 / -17 and -RL7 0 / -1 (07:10:05Z). Optical index: QRE1113 C606049 100 (jlcpcb-search QRE, 07:11:33Z) is QRE1113GR's DIP part and fails delay variation as it does; SFH 9202 C2927183 0 (07:12:09Z); SFH 9206-5/6 C2900460 4; TSSP94038/93038/95038 are 38 kHz modulated detectors with digital output; SFH 7072 (47) is a biosensor with no stated working distance. TCND5000 re-read: rise and fall times (15 ns) are stated for the emitter only, the photodiode states CD 1.8 pF (Rev. 1.6, https://www.vishay.com/docs/83795/tcnd5000.pdf, 07:12:22Z).
